content_blocks.label: clause_1._GRANTOR
content_blocks.text: I, Elizabeth A. Brown, being of sound mind and body, do hereby make, publish, and declare this my Last Will and Testament.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_EXECUTOR
content_blocks.text: I appoint Daniel K. Wilson as my Executor to carry out the provisions of this Will.
